_comment: AML alert rules, read by cde/jobs/build_gold.py (fact_aml_alert, dim_aml_rule). Amounts are INR.

rules.name: Cash structuring
rules.subject: ACCOUNT
rules.description: At least 3 settled cash deposits of 40,000 to 49,999.99 on one account within the last 3 business dates: kept just under the 50,000 at which a PAN must be quoted

rules.name: Pass-through account
rules.subject: ACCOUNT
rules.description: On one business date, at least 8 settled credits totalling 50,000 or more, and at least 90% of the credited amount debited out the same date

rules.name: Watchlist match on PAN
rules.subject: PARTY
rules.description: A golden party's PAN equals the PAN of an active screening-list entry (listed on or before the date, not delisted)

rules.name: Watchlist match on name and date of birth
rules.subject: PARTY
rules.description: A golden party's standardised, order-free name and date of birth equal an active screening-list entry's, with no PAN match
